seed: Objects of type `marker` under action ACTION6 with touching neighbours [hazard,wall] show mixed outcomes: no_change x2, gone x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the exact click position relative to the object, when the action is a click. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Blocks mode: ACTION1/2 move both cyan blocks up/down 4; ACTION3/4 move them apart/together, mirrored in x. Each block moves on its own and is blocked by marker cells, the other block, the board edge, or maze cells.
Clicking an inactive marker arms the game: blocks become color_1 armed players and the clicked marker turns active (11). ACTION1-4 then move the active marker by 4. Clicking a player disarms. Clicking an active marker or a block, and ACTION5, do nothing.
The hypothesis about mixed ACTION6 outcomes on markers does not hold: clicks always land on the marker top-left. no_change means a click on an active marker or on a block; gone is only re-ranking of names after a mode switch.
color_0 bars have width floor(3(n+1)/7), where n is actions since level start. n is tracked across calls only while the bar width matches; otherwise it falls back to the smallest n consistent with the bar.
Unconfirmed: the blocked moves come from a maze the extractor does not show. 3 inferred blocked 4x
